_comment: cardLife's cases - the Keys register's reader, as card_cases.json is
cardCell's. The suite builds 'now' as a fixed LOCAL noon and turns
expiryDay (days from that day, at 13:00 local) into job.expiry, so
today/live/dead hold in any timezone the runner picks. want is a
subset: only the named fields are asserted. null want = null answer.

cases.why: a cancelled job reads as nothing, like cardCell
a plain pair with days to live
the last day reads today, whatever the hour
a lost card stays written, leaves active
a card wiped at the reader is back, not active
back and lost clamp inside written, never negative counts
written clamps to qty, the run screen's own rule
mid-write, only written cards are out
no expiry reads dead, never eternal
